_doc: twin/camera.py stat_v1 parameters fitted by scripts/stat_v1_fit.py: detection, foot-point, burst, ID-switch and class-confusion statistics from DEV labels (Claude-agent labels, not human) vs DEV PERC tracks; ROI-energy quantiles and the motion threshold from TRAIN machines tables. Aggregates only.

energy.unit: roi_energy / the press's median idle train roi_energy (dimensionless)

P14a.running_source: assumed: pooled normalised pools of the P4-LEARNED presses (P9a, P9b)

P14b.running_source: assumed: pooled normalised pools of the P4-LEARNED presses (P9a, P9b)

P14c.running_source: assumed: pooled normalised pools of the P4-LEARNED presses (P9a, P9b)

P14d.running_source: assumed: pooled normalised pools of the P4-LEARNED presses (P9a, P9b)

motion_thr.rule: argmax over thresholds of TPR(moving) - FPR(idle) on the normalised energy; moving = the P4-LEARNED presses' train moving frames, idle = every press's idle train frames
